components.name: SOAP second moment in the eigenbasis (exp_avg_sq)
SOAP eigenbases q_row + q_col
components.applies_to: same 36 matrices (4.25× per MLP matrix, 2× per attn.v)

aux_note: AdamW m and v (exp_avg, exp_avg_sq) on embedding, LM head and 1-D params; the SODA anchor covers Muon matrices only
notes: The anchor is an fp32 clone taken at each matrix's first Muon step (the init, all-zero for the zero-initialized attn.proj/mlp.proj) and stays allocated after the pull fades to λ=0 at step 2750; like all Muon/SOAP state it is sharded across ranks with its matrix. NorMuon-lite second_moment row vectors (O(rows), live here with NOR_BETA2=0.95) are ignored.
evidence: Muon.step L588: state["momentum"] = torch.zeros_like(p) for every Muon param (model.blocks ndim>=2, L771)

Muon.step L589-592: if p in soap_params (SOAP_PARAM_MODE="mlp_plus_v" L112: mlp.fc, mlp.proj, attn.v) exp_avg_sq = zeros_like(p, fp32), row_gg = zeros(p.size(0), p.size(0)), col_gg = zeros(p.size(1), p.size(1))
soap_update_preconditioner L511-513: state["q_row"], state["q_col"] = soap_eigenbasis(row_gg / col_gg), replaced by soap_basis_qr every 10 steps
Muon.step L603-604: if SODA_HIDDEN (True, L63): state["soda_anchor"] = p.detach().clone() at the param's first step; used at L650 p.mul_(1 - lam).add_(state["soda_anchor"], alpha=lam)
Muon L597-602: state["second_moment"] is (m,1) or (1,n) -> O(rows+cols), not counted
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight], [proj.weight], [ndim<2 params], fused=True) L766-769 -> exp_avg + exp_avg_sq
